home.title: Where Heritage Meets Innovation

featured.title: A Legacy Crafted in Porcelain
featured.description: Discover the artistry, techniques, and cultural stories behind China's most celebrated ceramic traditions.

blueWhite.name: Blue and White Porcelain
blueWhite.description: Elegant cobalt-blue designs painted on pure white porcelain, celebrated for their timeless beauty.

celadon.name: Celadon
celadon.description: Subtle jade-green glazes and refined forms that embody harmony and understated elegance.

familleRose.name: Famille Rose
familleRose.description: Delicate enamel colors and intricate floral compositions showcasing exceptional craftsmanship.

museumPreview.title: Step Into the World of Chinese Porcelain
museumPreview.description: Explore the artistry of Chinese ceramics through an immersive digital museum experience. Discover traditional craftsmanship, historical heritage, and the timeless beauty of porcelain.

history.title: A Journey Through History
history.description: Discover the stories behind centuries of Chinese ceramic heritage.

craftsmanship.title: Traditional Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.description: Explore the techniques and skills behind porcelain artistry.

artistry.title: Timeless Artistic Beauty
artistry.description: Experience the patterns, forms, and elegance of Chinese ceramics.

designPreview.title: Tradition Inspires. Your Creativity Defines.
designPreview.description: Explore traditional Chinese ceramic patterns and discover new creative possibilities with AI-assisted design.

heritageJourney.title: Thousands of Years of Ceramic Excellence
heritageJourney.description: Discover how generations of Chinese artisans shaped one of the world's most celebrated ceramic traditions.

tang.name: Tang Dynasty
tang.title: A World of Color
tang.description: Tang ceramics became known for diverse forms and vibrant sancai three-color glazed pottery.

song.name: Song Dynasty
song.title: The Beauty of Simplicity
song.description: Refined forms and elegant monochrome glazes, including celebrated celadon traditions.

ming.name: Ming Dynasty

ming.description: Blue and white porcelain flourished, becoming one of China's most recognizable ceramic traditions.

qing.name: Qing Dynasty

qing.description: Famille rose and other sophisticated enamel decoration expanded the expressive possibilities of porcelain.
